caption.opening: If this week is heavy, sit with these two ayat for a minute.
body: In Surah Ash-Sharh the same promise appears twice, one ayah after the other: with hardship, ease.

A reflection for today:
→ name what is hard, honestly
→ look for the ease that is already beside it
→ ask Allah for patience and for relief

claims.text: Qur'an 94:5-6 pairs hardship with ease in two consecutive ayat.
Naming the difficulty, looking for ease and asking for patience and relief are ways to act on the ayah.
